messages:
Matt: quick sync 1: want to standardize a 'soft fallback' signal across adapters. current Optional<Route> -> nil is too blunt.

Sara: +1. we need a way to say 'acceptable but not preferred' so runtime/telemetry differentiate.

Jin: can you show the minimal shape? perf at 60k qps matters.

Matt: sketch: policy.evaluate(...) => status in {ACCEPT, SOFT_FALLBACK, HARD_FALLBACK}, candidate?: Route, reason_enum?: string, priority_delta?: int

Ben: runtime then can still route to candidate on SOFT_FALLBACK but tag spans and optionally deprioritize. good for cheap-region fallbacks.

Carla: require enums for reason (capacity_limited, latency_degraded, model_precision_tradeoff). freeform debug string only in sampled logs.

Sara: ops ask: metric soft_fallback_rate per tenant/model/region; alert if >5% for 5m on prod tiers.

infra-bot: deploy: policy-engine:v2 canary -> sandbox at 2024-05-01T09:12:03Z

Jin: perf note: status as 1 byte, enums as small ints, candidate pointer unchanged. negligible per-request overhead if we avoid allocations.

Ben: migration path? lots of adapters are v1 returning Optional<Route>.

Matt: runtime will accept both; v1 adapters map nil -> HARD_FALLBACK via shim. v2 adapters can emit SOFT_FALLBACK. add compatibility tests.

Carla: tests: ordering when soft_fallbacks present, sim for oscillation, canary on Dedicated first.

Sara: next steps: prototype v2 adapter shape + shim tests (Thu).
Jin: add telemetry fields + sim harness (Fri).

Carla: enumerate enums and map existing return paths (Thu).
Ben: docs + migration checklist (Mon).

Matt: one open question: should policy expose priority_delta so tenant SLA can override ordering?

Jin: propose optional priority_delta:int (negative to promote). default 0; maybe +10 for SOFT_FALLBACK. runtime ignores when tenant SLA==strict.

Sara: keep it optional. runtime should only use it when SLA allows.

Matt: consensus to include reason_enum + optional priority_delta. we'll add this to RFC and rollout plan.

infra-bot: ticket INF-1427 created: "policy-engine adapter v2 + soft_fallback rollout" assigned to @Sara @Jin @Carla @Ben

Matt: thanks all. Sara ping when PR is ready and Ill merge the RFC update.

Sara: will do, thx!
